[[Balthor Coalforge]] is a [[weaponsmith]], a type of [[NPC]] that [[craft]]s weapons in exchange for [[crafting material]]s and [[gold]] and/or [[customize]]s weapons. It costs 10 gold to get a weapon customized. 
Balthor Coalforge crafts the coveted [[Destroyer weapons]], the only weapons other than [[Tormented weapons]] or [[Oppressor's weapons]] that can be added to the [[Valor]] monument in the [[Hall of Monuments]].

All weapons come equipped with a replaceable [[inscription]] or [[upgrade component]].
*Martial weapons come with a [["Strength and Honor"]] [[inscription]].
*[[Shield]]s come with a [[Shield Handle]] [[of Fortitude]].
*[[Wand]]s come with a [[Wand Wrapping]] [[of Memory]].
*[[Focus]] items come with a [[Focus Core]] [[of Fortitude]].
*[[staff|Stave]]s come with a [["Hale and Hearty"]] [[inscription]].
*Items have no merchant value and cannot be [[Salvage|salvaged]].
